metadata.description: Themed packs of Claude Skills (Agent Skills) for Claude Code and Claude.ai. Each pack is an installable plugin bundling SKILL.md skills and shared reference files around one job to be done.

plugins.name: workshop-pack
plugins.description: 7 Claude Skills for running workshops that produce decisions: intention framing, agenda design, pre-work emails, facilitator run sheet, live capture of post-it walls, 48-hour synthesis, and the facilitation retro.

plugins.name: review-cycle-pack
plugins.description: 11 Claude Skills that run an annual performance review cycle without performance software: cycle planning, growth matrix, review forms, self-reviews, manager growth memos, 1:1 prep, and the end-of-cycle retro.

plugins.name: design-thinking-pack
plugins.description: 33 Claude Skills that carry a design project from a fuzzy challenge to a tested, decision-ready concept: challenge framing, interview guides and screeners, transcript synthesis, personas and journeys, HMWs and concept cards, prototype and test plans, and the stakeholder playback.

plugins.name: onboarding-pack
plugins.description: 12 Claude Skills that carry a new hire from "yes" to day 90: the pre-boarding plan, the internal setup emails for IT and finance, the cultural brief, the welcome pack, the per-joiner checklist and dashboard, the team deck, the intro email, the first goals, the first week, and the joiner's own 90-day companion.

plugins.name: compassionate-leadership-pack
plugins.description: 20 practical skills for compassionate leadership: feedback, conflict, workload, grief, change, exits, and more human workplaces. Includes portable prompts for ChatGPT and other assistants.
